thesis.title: Psychiatric medication access and healthcare financing
thesis.summary: A Bocconi thesis on how reimbursement, pricing, and regulation shape access to psychiatric medicines.
thesis.body:
The thesis asks how health financing and pharmaceutical policy affect the availability of psychiatric medicines. It uses a structured literature review and compares Italy, the United States, and selected European countries.

A case study of ADHD medications grounds the comparison. The thesis also applies utilitarian and Rawlsian frameworks to examine whose access improves under different policy choices and whose barriers remain.

synvera.title: Synvera Flow
synvera.summary: An ASU graduate team proposal for identifying mismatches between approved referrals and booked orthopedic appointments.
synvera.body:
The team examined how a patient can be booked with the wrong specialist after referral information changes. The proposal would compare the approved referral with the booked specialty and flag discrepancies for a scheduling coordinator.

My contributions included a proposed pilot evaluation and a financial model that identified the assumptions a clinic would need to test. The work was presented as a graduate team project.
